item.title: Alabama announces signing of late running back addition
item.description: Alabama football has announced the signing of Traeshawn Brown on Thursday. Brown is a 2026 running back out of Huntsville High School in Texas. He holds previous offers from Arkansas State, Navy, New Mexico State and others. The new Alabama running back addition is a 5-foot-10, 190-pound explosive back.
